title: eSIM activation preparation
disclaimer: FICTIONAL TRAINING CONTENT. Created for Fictional Telecom Lab; does not represent any real provider or legal requirement. Knowledge guidance only; no customer actions can be performed.

sections.heading: Device readiness
sections.text: Check that the device supports eSIM, has an internet connection through Wi-Fi, and is not restricted to an incompatible network. Exact device compatibility must be confirmed from approved model-specific guidance; this library contains no supported-model list.

sections.heading: Activation handoff
sections.text: An authorised colleague must complete the IDV-1001 and AUTH-1001 checks before issuing a fictional activation instruction through the approved service workflow. Do not post activation codes in the copilot. Avoid deleting an existing profile before the authorised colleague confirms the replacement process.

sections.heading: Service limits
sections.text: The copilot can explain preparation steps. It cannot issue a QR code, activate a service, inspect a device, or confirm a customer's account eligibility.
